test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following metals has least reactivity?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gold**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gold (Au)**
 
• Atomic Number: 79 
 
• Atomic Mass: 196.96657 u 
 
• Electron Configuration: [Xe] 4f14 5d10 6s1 
 
• Melting Point: 1064.18 °C (1337.33 K)
 
• Boiling Point: 2808 °C (3081 K)
 
• Density: 19.32 g/cm³ 
 
• Reactivity: Extremely low, resists corrosion and tarnish. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sodium (Na)**
 
• Atomic Number: 11
 
• Atomic Mass: 22.98976928 u
 
• Electron Configuration: [Ne] 3s1
 
• Melting Point: 97.72 °C (370.87 K)
 
• Boiling Point: 883 °C (1156 K)
 
• Density: 0.968 g/cm³
 
• Reactivity: Highly reactive, reacts vigorously with water and air. 
 
• **Silver (Ag)**
 
• Atomic Number: 47
 
• Atomic Mass: 107.8682 u
 
• Electron Configuration: [Kr] 4d10 5s1
 
• Melting Point: 961.78 °C (1234.93 K) 
 
• Boiling Point: 2162 °C (2435 K)
 
• Density: 10.49 g/cm³ 
 
• Reactivity: Moderately reactive, tarnishes in air due to sulfur compounds.
 
• **Mercury (Hg)**
 
• Atomic Number: 80 
 
• Atomic Mass: 200.59 u
 
• Electron Configuration: [Xe] 4f14 5d10 6s2
 
• Melting Point: -38.83 °C (234.32 K)
 
• Boiling Point: 356.73 °C (630.08 K)
 
• Density: 13.534 g/cm³
 
• Reactivity: Relatively low, forms amalgams with other metals.
